 	Old value: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Diagnostics\InitializingComponentProgress = PostPlatformUpdate
 	New value: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Diagnostics\InitializingComponentProgress = InitNriAgent
alerts.recommendation: Validate if policy change was authorized.
